description: This file contains functions and classes for interacting with LM Studio models, including loading model details, parsing model info, and managing model cache.

classes.name: LMStudioClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with LM Studio API.

methods.name: hasLoadedFullDetails
methods.description: Checks if a model ID has full details loaded.

methods.name: forceFullModelDetailsLoad
methods.description: Loads full details for a specific model from LM Studio.

methods.name: parseLMStudioModel
methods.description: Parses raw model info into a standardized ModelInfo object.

methods.name: getLMStudioModels
methods.description: Retrieves available models from LM Studio, including downloaded and loaded models, with deduplication.
